5: RUN apk --no-cache upgrade && ! keytool -list -cacerts -storepass changeit | grep -qiE 'emsign.*ecc.*g3'
6: RUN addgroup -S -g 10111 spinnaker
7: RUN adduser -S -G spinnaker -u 10111 spinnaker
8: COPY igor-web/build/install/igor /opt/igor
9: RUN mkdir -p /opt/igor/plugins && chown -R spinnaker:nogroup /opt/igor/plugins
10: USER spinnaker
11: HEALTHCHECK CMD curl http://localhost:8088/health | grep UP || exit 1
12: CMD ["/opt/igor/bin/igor"]
